content.text:
I submitted **index 30 (Ni 0.17, Sb 0.83)** as the best composition. At 1.08%, it had the highest EQE of the three I measured.

The episode allowed only three merit measurements:

| Index | Sb fraction | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 21 | 0.66 | 0.015 |
| 26 | 0.78 | 0.041 |
| 30 | 0.83 | 1.08 |

- **Starting point:** I began at index 21 because it matches the known NiSb₂O₆ phase, a Ni-Sb oxide already studied for photoanodes. It performed poorly.
- **Direction:** EQE rose sharply as Sb increased, so I spent the last measurement on index 30, the most Sb-rich composition in the library.
- **Gaussian-process suggestion:** The tool proposed index 14. With only two data points, its prediction was flat and uninformative, so I didn't follow it.

**What's uncertain:**
- The Ni-rich half of the library (indices 0–15) was never measured, so I can't rule out a better composition there.
- I don't know whether EQE keeps rising past 0.83 Sb or peaks just before it. Index 30 is the edge of the library, so nothing beyond it could be measured anyway.
- I didn't use any of the 5 XRD measurements, so which crystal phases are present is unconfirmed.
